gloss: water tanker truck; water supply truck

definitions.gloss: water tanker truck; water supply truck
definitions.explanation: A truck equipped with a large water tank, used to deliver drinking water to areas where the regular supply has been cut off—typically after earthquakes, typhoons, or other disasters.

examples.japanese: {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}が{到着|とうちゃく}した。
examples.english: The water tanker truck has arrived.

examples.japanese: {断水|だんすい}のため{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: We called for a water tanker because the water was cut off.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{後|あと}、{被災地|ひさいち}には{毎日|まいにち}{何台|なんだい}もの{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}が{派遣|はけん}された。
examples.english: After the earthquake, several water tanker trucks were dispatched to the affected area every day.

notes:
Compound of {給水|きゅうすい} (water supply) + {車|しゃ} (vehicle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}が{来|く}る: a water tanker arrives
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}を{派遣|はけん}する: to dispatch water tankers
- {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up at the water tanker

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in disaster-relief news. After a major earthquake or typhoon damages the water supply, local governments and the Self-Defense Forces dispatch {給水車|きゅうすいしゃ} so residents can fill containers with drinking water.
